EXAMPLE 08 — Bar Charts

Components: .bars, .bar, .vertical, .stacked, .grouped, .legend, .gray

--v is the bar length 0-100: value / largest value × 100, rounded.

Pattern A: horizontal bars, sorted, one colour

Sort the bars by value unless the categories have a natural order.

Pattern B: one highlighted bar, the others muted, next to the explanation

Colour only the bar the title is about; gray mutes the rest.

Pattern C: vertical columns for a time series

Time runs left to right; keep the categories in their natural order.

Pattern D: 100% stacked bars — every bar totals 100, so no total is shown

Segments take the categorical palette in order; the legend lists them in the same order.

Pattern E: vertical stacked columns — the tallest column totals 100

Each --v is the segment value / largest column total x 100, rounded.
Pattern F: grouped bars — two series per category; the largest single bar is 100
Pattern G: vertical grouped columns — three series per quarter

EXAMPLE 09 — Meters and Roadmaps

Components: .meter (status, target, .proportional), .legend, .roadmap,

.scale, .task

Pattern A: meters — one per measure, --v is the share filled (0-100)
Pattern B: bullet — the value against a target marker (--t)

Pattern C: proportional meter — parts of a whole in one bar, the rest is free

Each part's --v is its size / capacity x 100; the grey track is free space.

Pattern D: roadmap — floating bars from --from to --to (0-100 of the timeline)

One quarter = 25; one month = 100 / 12 ≈ 8.33. Same colour for the same workstream.

EXAMPLE 10 — Progress and Statements

Components: .toc-item.current, header breadcrumb, .progress, statement and

quote slide classes, .do / .dont, .bars.diverging

Pattern A: contents with the current section — repeat it before each section

Pattern B: progress indicator; the header directive sets the breadcrumb for
     this slide and the ones after it
Pattern C: statement — one number (h1) and the claim (h2)
Pattern D: statement on Gray 100 — a sentence alone, no number
Pattern E: quote — the quotation as a blockquote, the attribution after it
Pattern F: diverging bars — --v from -100 to 100, negatives also carry .neg
Pattern G: do / don't — pairs in .cols
